result.summary: Found 1 clear visual defect: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card's metadata row, which makes the delivery time and fee unreadable. The rest of the page (header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation) renders correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows two text strings drawn on top of each other. The delivery time ('25–35 min') and the delivery fee ('€0 delivery') occupy the same position, producing garbled text like '25–3€0 mdielivery'. Users cannot read the estimated delivery time or the fee.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items sequentially (e.g., a flex row with gap) instead of absolutely positioning them at the same origin. Render as '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' with separators, and make sure the row wraps or truncates gracefully on narrow screens.
